dataset: Catalan Dictionary PWA offline lexical data
licenseCompliance: Reuse must satisfy each source license. No commercial dictionary text is included.
modifications: Sources were normalized, merged, deduplicated, ranked, split into lemma-centred lexicon/morphology/prefix packs, and compressed for offline use.

bulkChinese.appPrivacy: No translation-service requests during app use.
bulkChinese.coverage: 83,805 additional lemmas / 95,319 selected source senses. Total Chinese presence: 97,668 of 97,675, including all 5,005 core entries. Seven source-insufficient records are explicitly held without filler.
bulkChinese.factReferences: Short original Chinese lexical facts checked against DIEC, DCVB, GDLC, official geographic tables and institution pages. No article wording or examples redistributed; URLs and audit metadata accompany the preparation snapshot.
bulkChinese.modifications: At most three selected source definitions or verified Spanish hints per lemma, otherwise the canonical Catalan headword. Source-compared corrections and literal grammatical templates retain exact evidence identities. Original, reviewed and aligned Wordnet Chinese take precedence.
bulkChinese.review: Machine-assisted, not human lexicographer approval; headword-only results labelled as term references.
bulkChinese.taxonomy: Exact Wikidata P225 references with Chinese labels where available; partial pinned CC0 snapshot; scientific name retained otherwise.

reverseSearch.modifications: Attributed reverse indexes and merged offline core. Uncorroborated Wiktionary Spanish fields excluded; traditional and simplified Chinese aliases generated with pinned OpenCC t2s/s2t tables.

wordnet.coverage: 10,789 missing-Chinese lemmas receive 15,654 corroborated source-reference senses. Counts measure source presence, not complete lexical coverage or accuracy.
wordnet.synsetScheme: Princeton WordNet 3.0 offset-POS; satellite adjectives normalized to a upstream

sources.modifications: Original reviewed seed entries are normalized and packed without machine translation.
sources.name: Catalan Dictionary PWA curated expressions

sources.attribution: English Wiktionary contributors; extraction by Kaikki/Wiktextract
sources.modifications: Catalan-language records were normalized, lemma/form records separated, fields deduplicated, and data packed into offline shards.
sources.name: Kaikki Catalan extract of English Wiktionary

sources.modifications: Catalan sections were parsed; wiki markup was reduced to plain definitions and translation/form templates were normalized.
sources.name: Catalan Wiktionary pages-articles dump

sources.modifications: Monolingual paradigms were expanded into a compact surface-to-lemma index; proper-name paradigms were excluded.
sources.name: Apertium Catalan monolingual dictionary

sources.modifications: Spanish-Catalan transfer entries were inverted only where their direction permits and merged as attributed Spanish equivalents.
sources.name: Apertium Spanish-Catalan bilingual dictionary

sources.attribution: FreeDict/WikDict/DBnary/Wiktionary contributors; maintained by Karl Bartel
sources.modifications: TEI headwords, grammar, definitions, translations, and pronunciation were normalized and merged into packed entries.
sources.name: FreeDict Catalan-Spanish dictionary

sources.attribution: Multilingual Central Repository contributors; Gonzalez-Agirre, Laparra and Rigau
sources.modifications: Exact normalized Catalan lemma and POS aligned by PWN 3.0 synset; only senses corroborated by an existing trusted Spanish equivalent are imported.
sources.name: Multilingual Central Repository (Catalan and Spanish), via Open Multilingual Wordnet

sources.modifications: Chinese equivalents for matched MCR synsets; +的 composition markers normalized, targeted holds applied, visible synonyms limited to three per sense, all accepted terms indexed. Labelled source references, not human-reviewed translations.
sources.name: Chinese Open Wordnet, via Open Multilingual Wordnet

sources.modifications: Bounded snapshot of exact P225 identities; no fuzzy name matching. Labels used only in short unqualified taxon glosses; no invented Chinese common names.
sources.name: Wikidata exact taxon-name Chinese labels
